Setting CPU and memory limits and requests for a container. To set, configure or specify container resource limits, add a resources section to the container in the Pod spec, with requests and limits for cpu and memory. Requests say how much CPU and memory a container needs; limits cap what it may use, and the kubelet enforces them.
